summary: Found and fixed a real bug: removedCurrentActor flag leak in startCurrentEntityTurn's startDied branch. When entity dies at start of turn (e.g. start-of-turn DoT like Bleed), processStartOfTurn calls removeEntity on the current actor, which sets removedCurrentActor=true. The startDied branch did not reset this flag, so the next nextTurn() call would enter skipAdvance=true and skip the shifted-in entity's end-of-turn buff tick. The curhp<=0 branch (dead-but-present) already had the correct reset. Added regression test.
